title: Order to Release
notes: Unlike most templates, this whole document is authored by the presiding judge/justice directly — there is no separate citizen applicant, so the judge running the command fills every field as "applicant" except the auto-filled date.

fields.label: Chambers of / Signature
fields.prompt: What is your name? You're the judge/justice issuing this order, so this becomes your signature.
fields.note: Appears twice: plain text in the 'Chambers of' header, cursive-rendered in the signature block. Same value both places.

fields.label: Order Number
fields.prompt: What is the SC-DOJ order number?

fields.label: Summary
fields.prompt: Provide a one-line summary of this order.

fields.label: Overview
fields.prompt: Provide the full overview/rationale for this order.

fields.label: Subject of Release
fields.prompt: Who is being ordered released from Bollingbrook?

fields.label: Judge's Title
fields.prompt: What is your title or rank?
